title: Regulated Communications Data and Provider Boundary

preflight.note: Created before classification-aware regulated communications, provider eligibility, regulated backup/export, or cross-repo policy implementation begins.

acceptance_criteria.text: Define a versioned ForgeLink data/communication classification contract that can map to ForgeWire regulated-data classes and survives agent-channel requests, approvals/evidence packs, contacts, timelines, SMS/MMS, voice/call data, notifications, callbacks, drafts/outbox, backup/export, retention/deletion, and audit/replay.

Provider and channel policy can restrict classified data by local-only/Twilio/Telnyx/future provider, SMS/MMS/voice/notification/webhook surface, recipient, purpose, and required provider agreement such as a healthcare BAA; disallowed routes fail closed or require an explicit governed redaction/downgrade decision.

Extend consent and communication-firewall evaluation so recipient consent/purpose, classification, channel, external-send authority, retention, and urgency are evaluated together. Product consent records do not make unsupported universal legal-consent claims for automated SMS/voice.

Define regulated backup/export/restore handling including encryption or protected destination requirements, operator warnings, retention, deletion, and migration behavior; sensitive plaintext exports cannot silently satisfy a regulated deployment profile.

Logs, provider errors, webhook diagnostics, notifications, screenshots/support bundles, audit chains, and RepoPact evidence preserve useful operational proof while minimizing or redacting regulated payloads, secrets, phone numbers, account identifiers, and health/financial facts.

Define and test deletion/retention behavior across messages, attachments, call history, contacts, agent requests, outcomes, backups, and audit evidence, including an explicit distinction between deleting payload content and retaining non-payload tamper-evident control evidence where policy requires it.

Add representative negative tests proving PHI/health, cardholder, financial/KYC, credential, and other restricted classes cannot silently leave through a forbidden channel/provider or appear in redacted notification, log, support, export, or evidence surfaces.

Document framework applicability and product boundaries without claiming HIPAA, PCI DSS, SOC 2, privacy, or communications-law compliance; identify customer/operator and provider responsibilities separately from ForgeLink controls.
